name: Cointegration residual convergence
hypothesis: Trade opposite an extreme residual using the frozen hedge coefficient.
spec: Setup: Fit and test a long-run relation on training data with stable residual behavior. Entry: Trade opposite an extreme residual using the frozen hedge coefficient. Exit: Exit near residual mean or on stability failure and hard loss limit. Parameters to pre-register: formation_window, hedge_model, stationarity_rule, z_threshold.
blocked_reason: needs simultaneous two-leg or basket execution with short legs; the engine trades one instrument per bot
